first.note: the curve runs into the left frame (x = 0 line; frame ink u 806 to 816, centre 811.6): sample at the frame's inner edge, u bound reaching the frame centre; no ink left of the frame

features.note: gradual bend made of two gentle sub-bends (curvature peaks near u 1480 and 1735), not a kink: straight stretches dv/du -0.544 (u 818 to 1370) and -0.420 (u 1800 to 2350), a 23 % change, with a short stretch at -0.474 (u 1560 to 1660) between them; knee at the curvature-weighted centroid of the whole bend (u 1571, Dr 0.50); u bound 80 px (about 0.05 in Dr), v bound = |slope| x 80 px + half the line thickness
